# Demand Range

> Demand Range is an Irish industrial lead and account research business serving Ireland, the UK and the EU. We build analyst-checked, industry-matched target account lists for suppliers of industrial equipment, technology and services, covering sectors such as water, pharma, food and beverage, and chemicals. Where public evidence exists, each account comes with project or development context.

Also written DemandRange or Demand.Range. Tagline: Industrial prospects. Matched to your market.

Key facts:
- Website: https://demandrange.com
- Contact: partners@demandrange.com, or request a written scope at https://demandrange.com/request-a-quote
- Markets served: Ireland, the UK and the EU. Each territory's sources and language needs are assessed per brief.
- Customers: suppliers of industrial equipment, technology and services, such as pumps and flow control, water and wastewater, process equipment, MRO, OEM components and distribution.
- Two research classes: industry-matched ("Look Alike") leads that match an agreed brief, and opportunity-signal leads with an identified, evidenced project or development. The target mix is about 90/10 but not guaranteed, and is agreed in writing.
- Deliverable: company-level account records with fit reasoning, sources, review dates and open questions. Named contacts, emails and direct dials are not included by default.
- What it is not: not a self-service data platform, live intent feed or contact database. It does not guarantee meetings, pipeline or revenue.

## Services

- [Industrial lead and account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lead-research): company-level prospect research for Ireland, the UK and the EU, scoped by country, sector, site rules and exclusions
- [Industrial lead generation for Ireland and the UK](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lead-generation-ireland-uk): account research for Irish and UK industrial markets using CRO, Companies House, regulator registers and public tenders
- [Opportunity Intelligence](https://demandrange.com/opportunity-intelligence): evidenced industrial project and development signals, separating observed change, supplier relevance and unknowns
- [Campaign activation](https://demandrange.com/campaign-activation): optional outreach, only under its own written scope, data review and approval
- [Markets and supplier fit](https://demandrange.com/markets): how account fit is defined by country, sector and customer route
- [Methodology](https://demandrange.com/methodology): how fit is checked, signals are classified and sources and unknowns are recorded
- [Request a quote](https://demandrange.com/request-a-quote)

## Guides for industrial sales teams

- [Industrial sales research guides and templates](https://demandrange.com/industrial-sales-resources): index of all guides and free CSV worksheets
- [Manufacturing enterprises in the EU by country and NACE division (2023 data)](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-enterprises-by-country): EU manufacturing enterprises by country and NACE division for 2023, from Eurostat, with a downloadable CSV and notes on what the counts can and cannot tell you
- [How to build a list of UK manufacturers](https://demandrange.com/uk-manufacturing-account-research): Companies House SIC codes as a filter, then site confirmation from UK regulator registers
- [How to use TED to find EU tenders for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/ted-eu-tenders-industrial-suppliers): CPV search, notice types and the 2026–2027 EU thresholds
- [CPV codes for pumps, valves and industrial equipment](https://demandrange.com/cpv-codes-industrial-equipment): official CPV wording for pumps, valves, instruments, water treatment and plant maintenance, with a free CSV starter list for tender alerts
- [UK public tenders for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/uk-public-tenders-industrial-suppliers): Find a Tender vs Contracts Finder under the Procurement Act 2023, and which notices matter
- [UK water industry supplier research (AMP8)](https://demandrange.com/uk-water-industry-supplier-research): water companies, framework contractors and DPC routes in England and Wales for 2025–2030
- [NACE Rev. 2.1 codes for industrial account lists](https://demandrange.com/nace-rev-2-1-industrial-account-lists): the manufacturing (Section C) changes and how to recode an existing target list
- [EU Industrial Emissions Portal for account research](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-emissions-portal-research): using the EEA's EU-wide facility data to find large industrial sites by country and activity
- [Germany industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/germany-industrial-account-research): Handelsregister, Unternehmensregister, WZ 2025 codes and other public sources for German manufacturers and plants
- [ZoomInfo or Apollo for industrial prospect lists?](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-vs-data-provider): when a data platform is enough and how to test any source
- [Industrial ideal customer profile](https://demandrange.com/industrial-ideal-customer-profile)
- [Industrial lookalike account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lookalike-account-research)
- [Industrial account prioritisation](https://demandrange.com/industrial-account-prioritisation)
- [B2B prospect list audit](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-audit)
- [Prospect list maintenance](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-maintenance)
- [Industrial MRO account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-mro-account-research)
- [EPC/EPCM equipment supplier research](https://demandrange.com/epc-epcm-equipment-supplier-research)
- [European chemical manufacturer research](https://demandrange.com/european-chemical-manufacturer-research)
- [Pump and flow-control prospect research](https://demandrange.com/pump-flow-control-prospecting)
